description: This is a Java test class for integration testing SAML2 login and logout flows using HtmlUnit and Spring testing frameworks.

classes.name: Saml2XmlITests
classes.description: Integration test class for SAML2 login/logout using HtmlUnit and Spring Test framework.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes MockMvc and WebClient before each test.

methods.name: authenticationAttemptWhenValidThenShowsUserEmailAddress
methods.description: Tests successful login displays user's email address.
